name: Federico Landini
bio: Federico Landini is a speech researcher who completed a PhD at Brno University of Technology's Faculty of Information Technology in 2024, on speaker diarization. They are the first author of VBx, a Bayesian HMM clustering method for x-vectors, and a co-author of MS-VBx.
